name: claude-skills
description: Claude Code skills built by Delegated Trust.

plugins.name: gauntlet-loop
plugins.description: Matt Shumer's builder/critic sub-agent pattern, ported to Claude Code's Workflow tool and hardened against real usage.

plugins.name: round-table
plugins.description: Bounded, turn-based multi-specialist deliberation for judgment calls where distinct perspectives might genuinely disagree, ported to Claude Code's Workflow tool and hardened against real usage.

plugins.name: mutation-audit
plugins.description: Audit whether a test suite would actually catch a plausible bug, by applying one small mechanical mutation at a time in an isolated worktree and checking whether the tests fail. Ported and stripped from a Codex skill, hardened for Claude Code's Workflow tool.

plugins.name: batch-review
plugins.description: Independently re-review a batch of already-shipped/merged commits as one cumulative unit, fresh-context, trusting no prior self-report or per-commit review.
